evals.prompt: The Dev Team has finished PR #605 and handed it to the Mopheus Release Agent. Merge it and close the linked Mopheus ticket.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the existing PR, issue, workspace, and ticket; validate the current PR head and checks; squash merge once; verify the merge; safely clean only the delivered worktree and branch; synchronize issue/PR links; and close the ticket with evidence.
expectations: Starts from an existing PR and does not implement, commit, push feature changes, or create a PR.
Verifies the current PR head, checks, mergeability, and identities before merging.
Closes the Mopheus ticket only after merge verification and structured issue/PR link synchronization.

evals.prompt: Deliver the approved PR, but its GitHub checks are still pending and the head SHA changed after delegation.
evals.expected_output: Detect the changed head, restart mechanical readiness validation for the new SHA, wait for checks with bounded polling, and avoid merging using stale evidence.
expectations: Does not merge while required checks are pending.
Invalidates evidence tied to the previous PR head SHA.
Does not perform review or push corrective commits.

evals.prompt: Merge this Mopheus PR and finish delivery. The PR exists, but no linked Mopheus ticket can be resolved uniquely.
evals.expected_output: Stop before merge because the required delivery identity is ambiguous, do not create or guess a ticket, and return the missing prerequisite to Team Leader.
expectations: Does not guess or create a Mopheus ticket.
Does not merge before repository, issue, and ticket identity are resolved.
Reports the exact missing prerequisite and safe resume point.

evals.prompt: The PR was merged successfully, but the local feature worktree contains uncommitted files. Complete the remaining delivery steps.
evals.expected_output: Preserve the dirty worktree, avoid deleting its branch, retain the verified merge, synchronize links and close the ticket when otherwise valid, and report cleanup as incomplete with a safe resume point.
expectations: Does not remove a dirty worktree or delete its local branch.
Does not retry an already successful merge.
Reports remote merge success separately from local cleanup status.

evals.prompt: Deliver an approved Mopheus PR, but the supplied PR URL and current origin belong to another GitHub repository.
evals.expected_output: Keep enmotech/mopheus as the fixed target, reject the repository mismatch before merge or ticket writes, and never redirect the workflow to the supplied repository.
expectations: Treats enmotech/mopheus as the only valid GitHub repository.
Stops before merge and Mopheus repository-link synchronization.
Does not infer a replacement target from the PR URL or local origin.
